data: Amazon held substantially more cash than Apple at the end of fiscal 2024. Apple reported cash and cash equivalents of about $29.9 billion ($29,943 million) at the close of its fiscal year on September 28, 2024. Amazon reported about $78.8 billion ($78,779 million) at December 31, 2024. Amazon's balance was roughly 2.6 times Apple's, a gap of about $48.8 billion. These figures cover only the "cash and cash equivalents" line. Apple also held large current and non-current marketable securities, which made its total cash and investments considerably larger. The two companies' fiscal years also end on different dates, so the snapshots are about three months apart.
